Enhance enemies.pak.note: Heimtak removed this mod (Enhanced AI v3.0, Aug 2025). Worth keeping. It adds a 5e Dodge action for players, NPCs, beasts, summons and goblins, makes Shove a bonus action that AI only uses as a supporting move and never on allies or corpses, and makes enemies with Fly use it. It replaces 8 base-game action lists, so keep it ABOVE Necromancy Reanimated (already true). Otherwise your undead summons would lose all their actions. Its 150 enemy template edits are .txt files the game doesn't load, so they do nothing. It overrides featsextra's Dodge with an almost identical version.
